# RealtHer Group

> Premier Greater Toronto Area (GTA) real estate brokerage advisory specializing in residential acquisitions, luxury listings, and historical market data analytics.

## Core Operations & Territory
- **Headquarters**: Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada
- **Licensed Jurisdiction**: Real Estate Council of Ontario (RECO), Toronto Regional Real Estate Board (TRREB)
- **Primary Markets**: Toronto, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Burlington, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Stouffville.

## Core Services
- **Residential Buying & Selling**: End-to-end representation for freehold detached homes, semi-detached, townhomes, and condominiums.
- **VOW Sold Property Intelligence**: Historical sold transaction pricing, original-to-sold spreads, and days-on-market metrics.
- **Comparative Market Evaluations**: Data-backed property valuation for GTA homeowners.
